commands.review_summary:
The PR requires exact resource-bound RunPod claims before stop/release can delete pods, adds reclaim and identity recheck coverage, updates RunPod docs, and adds a RunPod live smoke gate.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main resolves RunPod release-only requests through raw provider lookup and ReleaseLease terminates the resulting CloudID without a bound local claim. I did not run a live RunPod mutation in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] A maintainer or credentialed operator needs to provide exact-head live RunPod proof and accept the upgrade behavior; there is no narrow automated code repair to queue.

target.title: fix: bind RunPod release to exact claims
target.body:
## Summary

- bind RunPod destructive operations to exact local claims containing provider ID and pod name
- require explicit `--reclaim` adoption for unclaimed or legacy pods; never silently retarget an existing claim
- re-read the pod under the release lock and verify both ID and name before deletion
- reject ambiguous exact, normalized-name, and derived-lease lookups instead of adopting the first provider result
- preserve exact created-pod identity through readiness failure cleanup
- add a cleanup-armed, isolated-state RunPod live lifecycle canary and top-level live-smoke dispatch

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/801

## Verification

Current candidate: `003fee96a021ea3a6d9a741e552e81c00a35d0fe`

Local validation across the candidate stack:

- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
- `go test -race ./...` on parent `77eaf1f7aec792af3b63fd7516550e76b2eea9ec`
- `go vet ./...`
- `scripts/check-docs.sh`
- `node --test scripts/*.test.js` (379 passed)
- focused RunPod race tests covering mismatch rollback, explicit reclaim, retarget refusal, ambiguous-name/lease refusal, and exact-claim deletion
- `node --test scripts/live-runpod-smoke.test.js` (7 passed)
- `node --test scripts/live-smoke.test.js` on the exact current head (51 passed, including RunPod dispatch)
- full-branch autoreview clean with no accepted/actionable findings

Hosted validation on the exact current candidate: all 11 checks passed.

## Pre-merge live gate

Authenticated RunPod access is not available in the maintainer environment. Keep this PR unmerged until `scripts/live-runpod-smoke.sh` passes on this exact head, proving real pod create, SSH command execution, exact-claim stop, and zero-residue inventory cleanup; alternatively record an explicit item-specific waiver.

## Security / configuration

No new persisted-secret requirement. The live canary accepts `CRABBOX_RUNPOD_API_KEY` or `RUNPOD_API_KEY` only from the process environment and isolates its Crabbox state.
